shortDescription: Creates or removes custom fields from Nautobot

options.name: advanced_ui
options.description: Whether or not to display this field in the advanced tab

options.name: api_version
options.description: API Version Nautobot REST API

options.name: content_types
options.description: Content types that this field should be available for Required if I(state=present) and the custom field does not exist yet

options.name: custom_field_choices
options.description: List of choices to associate with this custom field (for select or multi-select types).

options.name: default
options.description: Default value for this field when editing models Must be in JSON format

options.name: description
options.description: Description of this field Also used as the help text when editing models using this custom field Markdown is supported

options.name: filter_logic
options.description: Filter logic to apply when filtering models based on this field Only compatible with I(type=text), I(type=url) and I(type=json)

options.name: grouping
options.description: Human-readable grouping that this custom field belongs to

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: key
options.description: Internal name of this field Required if I(state=present) and the custom field does not exist yet

options.name: label
options.description: Name of the field as displayed to users Required if I(state=present) and the custom field does not exist yet

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: required
options.description: Whether or not a value is required for this field when editing models

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: type
options.description: Data type of this field Required if I(state=present) and the custom field does not exist yet I(type=select) and I(type=multi-select) require choices to be defined separately with the I(custom_field_choice) module

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validation_maximum
options.description: Maximum value allowed for this field Only compatible with I(type=integer)

options.name: validation_minimum
options.description: Minimum value allowed for this field Only compatible with I(type=integer)

options.name: validation_regex
options.description: Regular expression that this field must match Only compatible with I(type=text)

options.name: weight
options.description: Position this field should be displayed in
